world_building_content: 以下各项互相独立，不是同一次对话；上下文只供理解，不额外翻译： 1. How now, spirit! Whither wander you?：Quince 的原文使用 How now / Whither；其后的 Ophelia 回答 Ah. Quince.（207行）。这不是 Hamlet 批次的延续。；语体：古雅戏剧开场 2. You sound terribly glum.：与206、207同行场；Quince 接着说 You sound terribly glum.；Ophelia 在210行说她很久未想到 Elsinore、如今想回去。勿据前句的古雅把本句文言化。；语体：日常关切 3. What, art thou ashamed of me?：16564行 Katherine 说 W-what, in the midst of the street?；16566、16567为相邻对话，使用舞台角色名 Petruchio / Katherine。；语体：戏中戏古雅反问和富文本强调 4. No, sir, God forbid, but ashamed to kiss.：紧接16566行 What, art thou ashamed of me?；不能把 ashamed to kiss 改成羞于对方本人。；语体：戏中戏否定与害羞对象 5. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.：FLAVOR_BernardoPraying；21206行动提示 am_cross，21207与21208连续，21210继续 And blessed is the fruit of thy womb...。；语体：祈祷庄重语体 6. Blessed art thou among women...：紧接21207行 Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.；引用祈祷文，非日常搭话。；语体：祈祷古雅语体 7. I don't buy it. Get thee gone, you sniveling suck-up.：25851行 Ophelia 说 We don't have to be at odds.；Brit 此句演出提示 [disgust] {Spare_Me}；25856是Ophelia内心话。；语体：讥讽、侮辱和古雅词混用 8. (...She still doesn't trust me. I wonder if there's something more I can do. Maybe I could find someone to help me.)：紧接 Brit 在25854行的拒绝。括号表示原文内心话；must 不得擅加到 wonder/maybe；保留两个 区间。；语体：内心话、否定与不确定性 9. My father has a saying for times like this. 'To thine own self be true.'：16693行 Ophelia 对 Bernardo 说 Bernardo—Katherine—whomever you desire to be...；本句明确引用父亲的格言。不要根据原著替角色猜性别。；语体：格言引用 10. No. I know I died.：属于 HamletStarter 的 occurrenceCount(...)=2 分支，470行为 Why am I still alive? I thought...；本条是 No. I know I died.；与主批次互斥，单独评阅。；语体：否定、确信与富文本 11. At yer service, m'lady!：characters.actors 的真实 presentline，角色交谈入口，不是前面场景的延续。；语体：粗犷口语与礼貌称谓 12. I am, in theory, above gossip... what would you like to say?：characters.actors 的真实 presentline，角色交谈入口，不是前面场景的延续。name_mapping 明确为 Lady Rosencrantz；bios 的角色条目也称她 she，不得按原著改作男性。；语体：略正式、自我调侃
